title: carex heleonastes var. lachenalii

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include its potential to aid in digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Carex heleonastes var. lachenalii for medicinal use.
